source_text: Plurimi sanctorum Patrum, Patriarcharum, et prophetarum desiderarunt eum videre, et coram spectatores fieri, et non potuerunt. Et alii quidem ex ipsis per visiones adumbratim in aenigmatibus conspexerunt: alii vero in columna nubis divinam vocem audierunt, et sanctorum Angelorum aspectibus potiti sunt: ad Mariam autem virginem solam sanctam, Gabriel Archangelus claro lumine venit, Ave gratia plena, ei adnuntians: et sic ipsa Verbum suscepit, et in tempore corporeae completionis, pretiosam Margaritam produxit.
thought_title: Many longed to see him, Mary alone received him
orientation: The preacher contrasts the patriarchs and prophets who only glimpsed the coming Lord with Mary to whom Gabriel came.
pass_a_gloss: Very many of the holy fathers, patriarchs, and prophets longed to see him, and to become witnesses before him in his presence, and they were not able. And some indeed from among them saw him in shadowy outline through visions in riddles: but others heard the divine voice in a column of cloud, and obtained sights of holy angels: but to Mary alone, the holy virgin, Gabriel the Archangel came in bright light, announcing to her, full of grace: and thus she herself received the Word, and in the time of bodily completion, she brought forth the precious Pearl.

choices.english: to become witnesses before him in his presence
choices.why: keeps coram as presence and spectator as witness rather than smoothing to see
rejected: to behold him face to face

choices.english: through visions in shadowy outline in riddles
choices.why: keeps all three Latin qualifications distinct and literal
potior with ablative means obtained or enjoyed, not simply saw
required by the brief glossary for the angel greeting
keeps the image from the previous section where Christ proceeds as a pearl

pass_b_english: Very many of the holy fathers, patriarchs, and prophets longed to see him and to stand as witnesses in his presence, but they could not. Some of them glimpsed him only through visions, in shadowy outline and in riddles. Others heard the divine voice from the pillar of cloud and were granted sights of holy angels.

But to Mary alone, the holy virgin, Gabriel the Archangel came in bright light, announcing to her, "Hail, full of grace" (Luke 1:28). So she received the Word, and in the time of bodily completion she brought forth the precious Pearl.
